name: Ferienwohnung Elisabeth
beschreibung:
Quietly situated in Bad Haering, Ferienwohnung Elisabeth welcomes guests with a warm ambiance and modern amenities. The tastefully styled rooms provide everything needed for a carefree stay.

The village's wellness and spa offerings as well as destinations like the Kaiser mountains and Kufstein are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Elisabeth in Bad Haering provides relaxation and comfort in the sunny spa village of Kufsteinerland.
